title: Bug: [DASH] Route Rule Table Del op is not supported for non-zero priority
author: vivekkarri
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

SAI rejects the DEL op for this Table if the priority is non-zero. 

This started to happen since https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/3534. with cache removed, orchagent only relies on KEY to delete the SAI object. 

But key only has ENI:VNI:Prefix. However, SAI also has priority attribute. 

To truly remove the cache, schema must be fixed. Until then a map with (key <-> priority) must be re-introduced

### Steps to Reproduce

```
[
    {
        "DASH_ROUTE_RULE_TABLE:497f23d7-f0ac-4c99-a98f-59b470e8c7bd:100:101.1.2.3/32": {
        },
        "OP": "DEL"
    },
    {
        "DASH_ROUTE_RULE_TABLE:497f23d7-f0ac-4c99-a98f-59b470e8c7bd:4321:25.1.1.1/32": {
        },
        "OP": "DEL"
    },
]
```



### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

This is also blocking ENI and VNET delete

Delete should proceed without any problems

### Relevant log output

```shell
2025 Jul 31 03:46:46.959357 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_generic_validation_remove: object 0x7008000000023 reference count is 1, can't remove
2025 Jul 31 03:46:47.953938 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_generic_validation_remove: object 0xe008000000022 reference count is 1, can't remove
2025 Jul 31 03:46:47.954349 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- flush_removing_entries: ObjectBulker.flush remove entries failed, number of entries to remove: 2, status: SAI_STATUS_OBJECT_IN_USE
2025 Jul 31 03:46:47.954349 sonic ERR swss#orchagent: :- meta_sai_validate_inbound_routing_entry: object key SAI_OBJECT_TYPE_INBOUND_ROUTING_ENTRY:{"eni_id":"oid:0x7008000000023","priority":"0","sip":"10.0.2.0","sip_mask":"255.255.255.0","switch_id":"oid:0x21000000000000","vni":"2000"} doesn't exist
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

Observed in master. 202505, 202506 branches
```
df4ce025c7aa01d751164d92bf15ce7e9dc86721
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_
